title: Origin story: Freyja
description: Freyja was the foremost of the Vanir, daughter of Njord, who came to Asgard as a hostage of the gods' peace and stayed as their most honored goddess. She wept tears of gold for her lost husband Odr, rode a chariot drawn by cats, and claimed half of all battle-slain for her own hall, Sessrumnir.

title: Power ranking: Freyja
description: Powers: The cloak of falcon feathers granting flight; The necklace Brisingamen, brightest of treasures; Choice of half of all slain warriors.

title: Stamina feats: Freyja
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Wept and wandered the worlds for her husband without ceasing; Stands unbowed before gods and giants alike.

title: Crossover notes: Freyja
